text.en: The sitios of Singalat, Upper Katipa, Calog, Bulawan, Amparo, Bangkal, Mabas, and Tingkob in the barrio of Siloy, Municipality of Calamba, Province of Misamis Occidental, are separated from said barrio and constituted into a distinct and independent barrio of said municipality, to be known as the barrio of Singalat.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval Approved, June 19, 1971.
